name: Joash
summary: A grandson of Jehu who reigned over Israel from Samaria for sixteen years. He wept at Elisha's deathbed, won back cities from Syria, and defeated Amaziah king of Judah.

key_moments.title: Strikes the Ground Only Three Times
key_moments.description: Joash wept over the dying Elisha, who had him shoot an arrow out of the window as a sign of victory over Syria. When Joash struck the ground only three times, Elisha said he would beat Syria only three times.

key_moments.title: Wins Back Israel's Cities
key_moments.description: After Hazael died, Joash took back from his son Ben-hadad the cities Syria had taken from Israel. He beat him three times.

key_moments.title: Defeats Amaziah and Breaks Jerusalem's Wall
key_moments.description: When Amaziah of Judah challenged him, Joash warned him with a story of a thistle trampled by a wild beast. Then he beat Judah at Beth-shemesh, broke down Jerusalem's wall, and took the temple's gold and silver to Samaria.
